thread:
maya: Heads-up: deployed sparse-attn-fusion v2 to a small canary (10%). quick summary below.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started 1991234565 by maya -> runtime:sparse-attn-fusion-v2 (10%)

zhou: nice. what numbers are we seeing?

maya: 25m window on mixed traffic: p50 -10%, p95 -8%, p99 -20%. token GPU cost -18%. biggest wins on mid-long seqs (512-2048).

kevin: p99 -20% is impressive. any evidence of output degradation?

maya: ran regression suite and sampling checks. perplexity diff < 0.4% and semantic-sim within noise. added conservative fallback: if attention-sparsity-score < 0.6 we route to dense kernel.

opsbot: NOTICE 1991234580: transient packing imbalance in ap-south-1 caused p99 +15% for 90s. Auto-rollout reduced canary to 5%.

maya: root cause: unexpected traffic skew produced many long, single-stream requests that defeated coalescing. mitigation: decreased packer.max_wait_ms for that region and enabled route affinity for long-streams. restored canary to 15% after 10m stability.

terry: what are the config flags and PR link?

maya: flags: "serve.sparse_attn_fusion_enabled" and "serve.sparse_attn_density_threshold". PR: https://git.redwood/inference/rollouts/pull/559 (perf graphs + fallbacks).

eva: can you paste the curl to fetch the canary metrics so I can add alerts?

maya: curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $RBW_TOKEN" "https://api.internal.redwood/infra/canary_metrics?exp=sparse_attn_fusion&window=25m" | jq '.summary'

opsbot: AUTO-RULE: runtime.sparse_attn_fusion.region.p99 > baseline*1.12 -> page oncall and rollback to previous kernel

maya: cadence: bump to 30% in 2h if no region p99 regressions, full ramp in 24h with ops + ml sign-off. will post updates. :rocket:
